import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=cands+['tensile_mpa']).copy()

print(d['cool_rate'].describe())
# robust regression
import statsmodels.api as sm
X = pd.get_dummies(d[cands+['lab']], columns=['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
X = sm.add_constant(X)
rlm = sm.RLM(d['tensile_mpa'], X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()

print(rlm.pvalues[['cool_rate','grain_size']])
# drop extreme cool_rate
q = d['cool_rate'].quantile([0.01,0.99])
d2 = d[(d['cool_rate']>q.iloc[0])&(d['cool_rate']<q.iloc[1])]
m2 = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ cool_rate + grain_size + C(lab)', data=d2).fit()
print("trimmed:", m2.params[['cool_rate','grain_size']].values, m2.pvalues[['cool_rate','grain_size']].values)
